In the meantime, my uncle managed to secure tickets for a flight the following afternoon through another source. Despite the fact that we weren’t giving them any business, Simran continued to stay in touch.

She helped us at every step, followed up at odd hours to keep checking if they managed to reach airport on time, whether the flights were on time, looking up their details to check if their names actually featured on the passenger list, kept checking if they boarded and followed up until they safely reached India

At a time when we were anxious and unsure about the situation on the ground, her constant reassurance and guidance meant more than words can express.

Deeply grateful to Jyoti Travels and especially to Simran for going above and beyond to help us — even when there was absolutely nothing in it for them. That kind of kindness and professionalism is rare. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

featured_reviews.name: Isha Keshri
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely dissatisfied with the services of the RPO website and overall passport process.
It has been over 4 months, and my application is still not forwarded to the police station for verification. Despite repeated follow-ups, there has been no progress.
I have already visited the RPO office 3–4 times, which is very inconvenient as we live far away. Every visit takes time, effort, and money, yet nothing changes. On top of that, emails are not answered and calls are never picked up, leaving applicants completely helpless.
When I contacted the police department, they clearly said they cannot proceed until they receive the file from RPO and that they cannot contact RPO themselves. This leaves the applicant stuck in the middle with no solution.
What is a common person supposed to do in such a situation?
This system lacks accountability, transparency, and basic communication. Such delays in an essential government service are unacceptable.
I strongly urge the authorities to improve response systems and ensure timely processing so that citizens do not have to suffer like this.
